newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize down in good volume.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize down in good volume.

text.p: Argentine cash maize prices dipped in hearty trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, as harvest pressure pushed bids down, traders said.

Prices paid to farmers for maize delivered to the port of Rosario lost $3 to $111. May soybeans also lost ground, undermined by a lower CBOT, dipping $3 to $300. Spot sunflower seed shed $2 to $208 in scanty turnover, with crushers arguing their margins are tight. Wheat was mainly weaker in another day of lacklustre trade in the twilight of the season. But wheat held its ground in Bahia Blanca at $145.
